Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the public funding of political campaigns for certain offices.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public funding of campaigns for local offices;and amending RCW 42.17.128.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.17.128 and 1993 c 2 s 24 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Public funds, whether derived through taxes, fees, penalties, orany other sources, shall not be used to finance political campaigns forstate ((or local)) or school district office. A county, city, town, ordistrict that establishes a program to publicly finance local politicalcampaigns may only use funds derived from local sources to fund theprogram. A local government must submit any proposal for publicfinancing of local political campaigns to voters for their adoption andapproval or rejection.
